description: Services d'informations en temps réel des transports en commun Naolib de Nantes Métropole au format SIRI is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Semitan. Services d'informations en temps réel des transports en commun Naolib de Nantes Métropole au format SIRI La norme SIRI (Service Interface for Real time Information) définit le protocole d’échange de l’information Temps Réel pour les transports collectifs (format XML). Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are réseaux, transport en commun, Naolib, siri, Temps réel, GCIV. The portal shows 3 records. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License-ODBL (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
